strongest_valid_opposing_point: Current evidence selects the native focus-scene design but does not authorize implementation incorporation. The legacy Work Pack assigns overlapping types.ts and store.ts ownership to 007T and downstream build/browser authority to 013B, 014, and 014V. strongest_unsupported_opposing_point: Calling a hash-bound launcher safe now overstates the evidence. It still needs an owned UI change, authenticated atlas route, drift behavior, rebuilt immutable handle, and browser negatives, while leaving the verified 237/231 focus failure untouched.
timing_boundary: Select the exact native focus-scene design now; defer implementation until one owned recomposition slice resolves the 007T overlap.
common_ground: Do not create a second shared editorial dataset.
Select one native four-node focus scene plus the literal directed portal.
remaining_disagreement: A launcher is not worth implementing as the immediate slice because it adds gateway/build/browser ownership without repairing the focus failure.
decision_rule: Authorize mutation only when one bounded Work Pack owns the overlapping UI/state bytes, immutable build rebinding, authenticated gateway/browser validation, and relationship to 007T.
next_acceptance_boundary: Reproduce the 237/231 baseline, then prove exact four-node, internal-edge, and portal arrays; exclusion of one unrelated node; pointer/Enter/Space/Back/breadcrumb/persistent-state/reduced-motion parity; fresh immutable build; and fail-closed gateway behavior.
claim_ceiling: Confirmed design target and local structural acceptance contract only.
